question:
**Direction: Which of the following options is most similar in meaning to the given word?**

Allude
solution:
The correct answer is **"Refer."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Allude"** means to refer to something indirectly or to hint at something. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु के बारे में अप्रत्‍यक्ष रूप से बात करना, संकेत मात्र देना)

 
 
• **Example**: *He **alluded**__ to problems with the new computers.*
 
 
 
• **"Refer"** also means to mention or allude to something. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु के विषय में उल्‍लेख या चर्चा करना)
 __
 
• **Example**: *He **referred**__ to page number 10.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, **"Refer"** is the most similar in meaning to the given word.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1, "Tell",** means to communicate or convey information directly. (कुछ बताना, जानकारी देना (बोलकर या लिखकर))
 
• **Option 3, "Demonstrate", **means to show or prove something. (प्रमाण देकर सिद्घ करना)
 
• **Option 4, "Instruct", **means to give directions or teach someone how to do something. (किसी व्‍यक्ति को आदेश देना; कुछ करने का निर्देश देना)
